note: Jefferson Davis Parish zones its unincorporated land (districts such as A-1, C-1) by ordinance, with the zoning map amended by ordinance and published as PDF. The parish GIS is a vendor viewer (jdpe.totaland.com) that exposes no ArcGIS REST service I could find; the Police Jury site, Municode and the Jennings city site name no queryable zoning layer. Searches of ArcGIS Online and Hub for zoning in Louisiana found no Jefferson Davis layer. Regrid's zoning fields are third-party parcel data at about 30% coverage, not a district layer.
